verses.69:19: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ

meaning: In Quran 69:19, هَاؤُم is an imperative expression meaning roughly 'here, take/read'. It should not be derived from an unrelated root sense of contemptibility.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
